nodes.description: Public mapping(string => address) storing proxyTarget and proxyOwner used for ownership checks and delegatecall target.
Constructor receiving _proxyTarget; initializes addressManager["proxyTarget"] and sets proxyOwner to msg.sender.
Modifier that lets the owner execute the guarded body, otherwise forwards the call to _doProxyCall via _doProxyCall/_doProxyCall path.
External payable fallback that unconditionally proxy-calls through _doProxyCall for any caller.
External owner-guarded function updating addressManager["proxyTarget"] with the supplied _proxyTarget.
External owner-guarded function setting addressManager["proxyOwner"] to msg.sender.
Internal function performing delegatecall(msg.data) to addressManager["proxyTarget"] and returning/reverting raw returndata.
Untrusted caller address used for ownership assignment, ownership transfer and modifier access checks.
Low-level delegatecall to a mutable, owner-updatable target with attacker-controlled msg.data, executed in the proxy storage context.
Inline assembly that returns or reverts propagating raw returndata bytes to the caller.
Constructor parameter address _proxyTarget stored as the initial proxy target.
Address parameter _proxyTarget used to overwrite the proxy target entry.
Local bool capturing the success flag returned by the delegatecall.
Local bytes holding the raw data returned by the delegatecall.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into addressManager["proxyOwner"] during construction, establishing the privileged owner.
Constructor parameter _proxyTarget is stored in the mutable addressManager mapping slot "proxyTarget".
The modifier compares msg.sender against addressManager["proxyOwner"] to decide whether the guarded body executes.
setTargetContract is wrapped by the proxyCallIfNotOwner modifier, so the modifier gates entry to the body.
transferProxyOwnership is wrapped by the proxyCallIfNotOwner modifier, so the modifier gates entry to the body.
When the caller is not the owner the modifier forwards execution into _doProxyCall, an arbitrary external delegatecall.
_proxyTarget parameter overwrites the addressManager["proxyTarget"] entry used as the delegatecall destination.
transferProxyOwnership mutates the addressManager["proxyOwner"] entry that controls all guarded functions.
msg.sender becomes the new proxyOwner, granting full control over the proxy target.
The payable fallback unconditionally forwards the call to _doProxyCall, enabling arbitrary delegatecall entry.
Any external msg.sender can reach the fallback and thereby trigger the delegatecall proxy path.
_doProxyCall executes the low-level delegatecall to the stored proxy target with msg.data.
The delegatecall destination is read from the mutable addressManager["proxyTarget"] mapping entry.
The success boolean is the value returned by the delegatecall.
returndata holds the raw bytes returned by the delegatecall.
_doProxyCall branches into the inline assembly block that returns or reverts with the raw returndata.
The returndata pointer is passed into the assembly return/revert, propagating unvalidated bytes.
The success flag selects whether the assembly return or the assembly revert branch is executed.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _proxyTarget only feeds the owner-controlled proxy target slot and carries no independent semantics beyond the constructor.
Address parameter _proxyTarget is used solely inside setTargetContract to overwrite the delegatecall target entry.
Local success is just the delegatecall outcome inside _doProxyCall and adds no separate dataflow node.
Local returndata is produced by the delegatecall unsafe operation and should be folded into that operation.
